scripts.build: bun run build:ts && bun run build:css
scripts.build:ts: bun build app/assets/ts/common.ts app/assets/ts/paywall.ts app/assets/ts/classifier.ts --outdir app/static/js --minify --target=browser --format=iife
scripts.watch: bun build app/assets/ts/common.ts app/assets/ts/paywall.ts app/assets/ts/classifier.ts --outdir app/static/js --target=browser --format=iife --watch
scripts.dev: bun run watch:css & bun run watch & uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8001
